hypothesis: update_trip_dates recalculates and shifts day_number based on start_shift = (old_start - new_start).days. When rescheduling an itinerary (e.g. from 10/10-10/12 to 10/15-10/17), all activities with day_number <= shift_abs are modified to shift_abs + 1, and then compressed to new_days. This scrambles existing activities and causes multi-day activities to all be merged into Day 1 or truncated.

update_trip_dates only queries trip_members to check permission, but fails to check if user_id == trip['created_by']. Legacy trips or sample trips where creator is not explicitly in trip_members may either be rejected (403) or lack strict creator privilege verification.

executeDateRangeUpdate in itinerary-view.tsx does not clamp focusedDay when duration is shortened, and totalDays uses Math.max(daysFromDates, maxDayFromItems) which causes optimistic updates to fail to reduce totalDays if optimisticTrip.days is not pruned.
